versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Crypto Market Rank skill.

- Query crypto token rankings, trending tokens, top searches, Binance Alpha picks, tokenized stocks, and meme tokens.
- Access social hype/sentiment leaderboards and social summaries.
- Discover smart money inflow token rankings.
- Browse top-performing trader PnL and win rates.
- Supports BSC, Base, and Solana chains.
- Flexible filtering and ranking options for targeted research.
